small_works.finding: derive_ai_heartbeat now makes runtime_evidence.enabled=false override all freshness checks, but does not require runtime_evidence.checked_at to be fresh. A stale persisted false can therefore classify RECOVERY_REQUIRED indefinitely even if the scheduler was later re-enabled but repository persistence lagged. This conflicts with the stated rule that actual scheduler runtime is authoritative.

small_works.recommended_fix: Treat enabled=false as authoritative only when checked_at is present and fresh enough for the runtime-evidence contract, or when corroborated by current scheduler evidence. Otherwise classify OBSERVABILITY_STALE/EVIDENCE_PENDING and request refresh. Add regression tests for fresh false, stale false, and later re-enabled evidence.
